So the back story is I found a copy of lead green on my phone. I was in Veridian city with nothing but a bulbasaur. The story begins.

Snoodles came back to life after a long slumber. Disoriented he looked around the field he found himself in. Scanning the tall grass he recognized the surroundings and found himself not far from his home town of pallet.

Checking on his trusty sidekick Bulbasaur Snoodle decided to catch him a friend. After checking to make sure he had a few pokeballs Snoodle started walking around the field. He came across a few pidgeys and a rattata declining on capturing them. Instead letting Bulbasaur gleefully stampede over them using her tackle attack.

That's when Snoodles met him. Arrising from the grass was a creature Snoodles never thought he would see. He brought out his pokedex and scanned the creature. It said it was a Mankey. But Snoodles has seen the Mankeys perform at the circus. This wasn't it. This creature was about 6 feet tall and purple.

Snoodles wanted to capture it.

He debt outbulbasaur to weaken the creature. And was shocked when this purple pokemon used confusion, severely disorienting his pokemon. Bulbasaur was undeterred by the forocious attack and struck the imposter Mankey with two vines that snaked out of his back.

Then Snoodles reached into his pouch and pulled out a pokeball, Throwing it right at the creature.

That's when everything went dark. Snoodles say frozen in an odd world of emptiness.

After and eternity or perhaps just mere seconds. Snoodles awoke in the field again.

Was it all just a dream? His bulbasaur was healthy, he wasn't missing any pokeballs. Confused and still focusing on that mysterious creature, Snoodles set across the field, back to town and the pokemon center.

That's when the creature appeared again and revealed his true name. Mewtwo.

Snoodles has heard the old legends of this mythical pokemon. They say it was genetic experiment that killed its creators. What in the name of sanity was a level 3 Mewtwo doing Veridian City?

Scratching his head Snoodles decided to try and capture it again. After a quick battle he three a pokeball. Everything once again went black and he found himself in that eerie nothingness where time ceased to exist.

Snoodles awoke in the field once again. Irritated that his previous attempts have dissolved to nothing. He set about to try and catch a pokemon, any pokemon would do.

He found a spearow and fought it. When he threw the pokeball he blacked out once again.

Snoodles decided to experiment further. He left the field and started walking back to pallet town. He came across a rather I'll tempered ratata hiding in a small shrub. He conquered the small rat and threw a pokeball. Once again blacking out.

Waking up in the field again. Snoodles was feeling very discouraged. He had set out on his journey just days ago. Or was it weeks? Perhaps months had passed. Snoodles was having trouble remembering exactly when he started out from his small home town.

He knee for certain that he had promised his mother that he would become a pokemon master. Now how could he do that? If he couldn't catch any pokemon, was it even possible to achieve his dreams of conquering the Elite Four? Snoodles sat down on a rock and contemplated the obstacles that lay before him. He racked his brain of all the tales he had heard from passing traveler's about pokemon that could be bought or won or generous folks who even gave away some for free.

Finally Snoodles decided to give his pokeballs one last try. If that doesn't work then he will just have to see how far he can make it. After all he can't just return home when he's only made it to the next town.

Snoodles heads north, past a dottering old man who only adds insult to injury with his patronizing demonstration on how to catch pokemon. Further north to a small patch of grass just north of town. He finds a weedle gnawing on a dead log and easily gets it down to low health. Amongst these tests bulbasaur has gained quite a few levels and is getting quite tough.

Snoodles throws the pokeball and once again all goes black. Waking up Snoodles knows that there's no hope of catching them all. But there is hope of continuing on his path and making his mother proud.

Snoodles sadly walks back to town and begrudingly sells all his pokeballs. With the money he buys a dozen potions and some other meds to keep his prized and only companion healthy.

Then Snoodles walks back to the field where this all began. He levels a vengeance upon any unfortunate pokemon to rear its head and challenge him. He slaughtered everything. Bulbasaur s vines were whipping about as creatures fell.

Finally it was time to face my rival. An old neighbor of mine, I've forgotten his really name. But everyone just calls him Asshole.

He talked some shit but Snoodles wasn't afraid. Their talent as trainers would be the real test. Assholes pokemon barely survived the beating. Charmander was the only one who really damaged Bulbasaur. But it really just made her fight harder. After a quick potion his pokemon ceased to have the ability to continue the fight.

Victorious over that cocky Asshole. Snoodles set out on his journey. Veridian forest lay beyond him, but his eyes were set on his first badge. Brock and his rock pokemon will be no match for him.

He looked down at his Bulbasaur and scratched her behind her ears.
